reason: Document B gives the traffic-focused commissioners and the worried neighbours a real answer: a signal paid for by the builder that keeps Alder and 4th at a C rating, made a condition of the permit. It also discloses the speaker's church membership, which builds trust. Document A treats the drop to a D rating as a minor inconvenience and claims, without support, that the project won't push cars onto local streets. That would put off this room.
